pages.text: Upgrade weapons and armor at a smithing table using a Singularity Ingot and the dedicated smithing template.$(br2)The Seven Swords of Terminus becomes the Constellation Treasury, while Origin armor becomes the corresponding Singularity armor. Wearing the full armor set provides extremely powerful defense.

An upgrade of the Seven Swords of Terminus that summons Treasury Treasures based on stored weapons for follow-up attacks.$(br2)See $(l:singularity/constellation_treasury)Constellation Treasury$(/l) for storage controls and interaction with the Arsenal Bow.
Enhanced Angel Ring. $(br)Enhances the original effect and also nullifies fall, suffocation, and void damage.
Enhanced Crimson Plate of Justice. $(br)Reflected damage becomes special fixed damage, and the damage dealt is doubled. It also nullifies physical damage.
Enhanced Leggings of Saga. $(br)In addition to the original effect, it also nullifies magic, wither, and projectile damage.
Enhanced March of the Ruler. $(br)Increases movement speed and nullifies all debuffs. It also negates fire and terrain damage.
